canonical_lexical_closest_comparison.compared_stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is reviewing a proposed collaborative practice agreement before signing it. Which features does the statutory definition require for the agreement to be validly constituted? Select all that apply.

compared_choices.text: It must be written and signed by the pharmacist and the supervising physician.
The collaborative practice may extend beyond the supervising physician's own scope.
It is subject to review and renewal on a biennial basis.
It must be filed with the Board before the pharmacist may act under it.
It must include individually developed guidelines for any prescriptive practice.
